create.name: Julie Ela Grace
create.bio:
Julie Ela Grace is a yoga and meditation teacher and writer based near Oxford. She came to practice in 2004 and found her home in Kripalu yoga, a gentle, inward-looking style that asks students to notice what is happening in body and mind and to meet it with kindness. She has now taught for more than ten years, and alongside her classes she studied literature and the medical humanities and writes about wellbeing for magazines and online platforms. Gratitude and compassion sit at the centre of her teaching, and her short morning gratitude practice is one of the most played tracks in her Insight Timer library.

In Oxford she leads a weekly all-levels Kripalu class at Hinksey Village Hall and visits students at home for private lessons. Online she holds a Tuesday evening restorative session using bolsters, blocks and blankets, offers one-to-one yoga by video, and gives spiritual coaching sessions for people who feel stuck in their practice or unsure of their direction. She has also led retreats in Italy. On Insight Timer she shares guided meditations for adults and children and a ten-day course on bringing the yamas and niyamas, yoga's ethical guidelines, into ordinary life.

courses.title: Kripalu Yoga on Mondays in Hinksey
courses.description: A weekly 75-minute Kripalu yoga class on Monday evenings at Hinksey Village Hall in Oxford. Open to every level, booked online class by class.

courses.title: Restorative Yoga at Home
courses.description: A slow online class on Tuesday evenings, lasting 75 minutes. Students rest in supported poses at home, so a bolster, block, strap and blanket are needed.

courses.title: One-to-One Yoga
courses.description: An hour of private yoga teaching in your own home around Oxfordshire, for beginners or for those refining an existing practice. Travel and parking are charged on top, so get in touch before booking.

courses.title: ONLINE: One-to-One Yoga
courses.description: A private hour-long yoga lesson by video, shaped around where you are in your practice. Booked by contacting Julie directly.

courses.title: Guidance on the Path
courses.description: Hour-long online spiritual coaching sessions for anyone feeling stuck in their practice or unsure of the next step. Julie helps you listen to your own intuition and find a steadier footing.

courses.title: Applying The Yamas & Niyamas To Everyday Life
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course that takes yoga's ethical guidelines one at a time and looks at how each can shape daily choices and relationships.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Julie Ela Grace on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile collects guided meditations on gratitude, compassion and calm, including many practices written for children. All of the single tracks can be heard free.
